title: Specialization invariance of section-germ bijectivity
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, and $G$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Suppose every module-stalk specialization associated to a geometric point of a strict localization is bijective [def-weil-pbc-etale-module-stalk-specialization]. Let $U\to S$ be etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], $M$ a $\Lambda$-module and $f:M\to G(U)$ linear. Let $a:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to U$ and $b:\operatorname{Spec}\Xi\to U$ be geometric points with algebraically closed fields and underlying ordinary points satisfying $a\rightsquigarrow b$. Then $\operatorname{germ}_a\circ f$ is bijective if and only if $\operatorname{germ}_b\circ f$ is bijective, where both germs are taken in $G$ using the indicated lifts to $U$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Neither $M$ nor $\Lambda$ need be finite.

proof.text: Transport the small spectrum limit cone along the double-opposite equivalence and the Gamma-Spec unit isomorphism. Initiality of the affine pointed-neighbourhood inclusion extends it to a limiting cone over all pointed etale neighbourhoods. Its legs still factor through the structural map.

proof.text: Pull back each pointed S-neighbourhood along U → S and point the fibre product with its given lift and b. The full limit cone at b on U followed by the fibre-product first projections is a cone over S-neighbourhoods. Its universal map gives H_U → H_S. Apply the cone equation to the diagonal U → U ×_S U to see that its projection to (U,b) is the structural map H_U → U.

proof.text: Lift the prescribed geometric generization a to H_U. Its composite with H_U → H_S has projection a to (U,b). Thus the specialization germ formula carries every germ at b of a section over U to its germ at a.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_section_germ_bijective_specializes_iff
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (G : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hsp : ∀ (Ω Ξ : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Field Ξ] [IsAlgClosed Ξ]
      (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (t : Spec (.of Ξ) ⟶ strictHenselizationScheme s),
      Function.Bijective (etaleModuleStalkSpecialization s t G))
    (U : S.Etale) (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (f : M ⟶ G.obj.obj (op U))
    {Ω Ξ : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Field Ξ] [IsAlgClosed Ξ]
    (a : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U.left) (b : Spec (.of Ξ) ⟶ U.left)
    (h : a (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) ⤳ b (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ξ)) :
    Function.Bijective (f ≫ (pointSmallEtale (a ≫ U.hom)).toPresheafFiber U
      (Over.homMk a rfl) G.obj) ↔
    Function.Bijective (f ≫ (pointSmallEtale (b ≫ U.hom)).toPresheafFiber U
      (Over.homMk b rfl) G.obj)
